Design system (default brand)

Every role, step and component, rendered from this project's tokens: 176 tokens, 2 themes. Generated by ds build; do not edit.

Colour roles

Components read only these. Values are listed per theme.

  • color-bg
    Page background.
    #f7f6f6 / #1a1816
  • color-surface
    Cards, dialogs, fields: anything raised off the page.
    #ffffff / #2c2825
  • color-surface-muted
    Secondary fills: a sunken panel, a tonal button, a tag.
    #eeeceb / #413c39
  • color-surface-inverse
    A dark band inside the light theme (or the light one inside dark).
    #2c2825 / #eeeceb
  • color-border
    Dividers and card edges. Decorative: no contrast requirement.
    #dddad8 / #413c39
  • color-border-strong
    Borders that identify a control (fields, outlined buttons). 3:1 against its ground.
    #867f7a / #867f7a
  • color-text
    Body copy and headings.
    #1a1816 / #f7f6f6
  • color-text-muted
    Secondary copy: captions, hints, metadata.
    #69625d / #c5c0bc
  • color-text-on-inverse
    Text on surface-inverse.
    #f7f6f6 / #1a1816
  • color-text-on-inverse-muted
    Secondary text on surface-inverse.
    #c5c0bc / #544e4a
  • color-link
    Inline link text.
    #27566a / #a5c7d7
  • color-focus
    The focus ring. 3:1 against every ground it can sit on.
    #376b81 / #78a6bb
  • color-action
    The primary action: the one thing the page is asking for.
    #27566a / #a5c7d7
  • color-action-hover
    The primary action under the pointer.
    #1c4252 / #c9dfe9
  • color-on-action
    Text and icons on action and action-hover.
    #f7f6f6 / #1a1816
  • color-accent
    A second emphasis, used sparingly. May alias action.
    #7f3800 / #f4af89
  • color-accent-hover
    The accent under the pointer.
    #632a00 / #fdd0b8
  • color-on-accent
    Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.
    #f7f6f6 / #1a1816
  • color-success-surface
    Success: background of a badge or alert.
    #f1f9f3 / #001f0d
  • color-success-text
    Success: text on success-surface.
    #0c4929 / #c5e4ce
  • color-success-border
    Success: the edge of a badge or alert.
    #9ecfad / #0c4929
  • color-warning-surface
    Warning: background of a badge or alert.
    #fef5ec / #251400
  • color-warning-text
    Warning: text on warning-surface.
    #563500 / #f2d6b6
  • color-warning-border
    Warning: the edge of a badge or alert.
    #e3b886 / #563500
  • color-danger-surface
    Error or destructive: background of a badge or alert.
    #fff4f2 / #360100
  • color-danger-text
    Error or destructive: text on danger-surface, and a field error message.
    #740e07 / #ffcdc5
  • color-danger-border
    Error or destructive: the edge of a badge, an alert, an invalid field.
    #ffa698 / #94170e
  • color-info-surface
    Information: background of a badge or alert.
    #f3f7ff / #001047
  • color-info-text
    Information: text on info-surface.
    #043093 / #c8dbff
  • color-info-border
    Information: the edge of a badge or alert.
    #a0c1ff / #043093
  • color-disabled-surface
    A control that cannot be used yet. Exempt from contrast, never from legibility.
    #eeeceb / #413c39
  • color-disabled-text
    Text on disabled-surface.
    #867f7a / #a39d98
  • color-shadow
    The colour every resting shadow is built from. Tinted by the ink, never pure black.
    #1a181614 / #1a181666
  • color-shadow-strong
    The colour of the raised shadows.
    #1a181624 / #1a18168c
  • color-backdrop
    Behind an open dialog.
    #1a181680 / #1a1816b3

Type

Fluid steps grow from their phone size to their wide size between 360 and 1280px.

  • --text-xs
    Fine print, legal lines. Never body copy.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-sm
    Captions, hints, metadata, badges.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-md
    Controls: buttons, fields, navigation.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-lg
    Body copy.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-xl
    Lead copy: the sentence that sums a section up.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-2xl
    The smallest heading.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-3xl
    Section subheadings.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-4xl
    Section headings.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-5xl
    The page title.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-6xl
    A hero line or a headline figure. One per page.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-display
    Hero headline. Re-alias to move the whole role.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-h1
    <h1>.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-h2
    <h2>.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-h3
    <h3>.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-h4
    <h4> and below.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-body
    Running text.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-ui
    Buttons, fields, navigation.    Sphinx of black quartz
  • --text-small
    Secondary lines.    Sphinx of black quartz

Buttons

A button is a decision the page is asking for. Anything else is a link.

On the inverse ground

Text, links, focus and outlines re-point themselves on a dark band. An inline link stays legible, and a card inside stays a light surface.

Standalone link

A card on the band

Its text is the default ink again, not the band's.

A link inside the card

Links

An inline link is underlined, so it is never found by colour alone.
